title: adventurous buttery venezuelan plantains casserole
description: a rich and flavorful venezuelan-inspired dish featuring crispy plantains, creamy creme patissiere, and a tangy mother sauce base, all combined in a satisfying casserole. perfect for adventurous eaters and those looking to try something new.
instructions: preheat the oven to 375f (190c) and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with avocado oil.
slice the plantains into 1-inch rounds and layer them in the bottom of the baking dish.
in a large skillet, sauté the diced onion and minced garlic over medium heat until softened.
add the cocoa powder, ground cinnamon, ground cumin, and salt to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
pour the creme patissiere and mother sauce base over the plantains in the baking dish.
sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top of the casserole and dot with the sautéed onion and garlic mixture.
cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
remove the casserole from the oven and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
